source_evidence.establishes: Fresh factory/run-root construction and explicit resume/import lifecycle inputs.
Initial guidance and populations are assembled before iteration one.
Phase 2 and Phase 3 complete before the next iteration samples.
Working guidance sampling, solver rollout, evaluation, changed-guidance production, and admission order.
Workspace materialization and final guidance extraction.
Population score synchronization before later selection.
Run-scoped lineage/artifact persistence and population RNG ownership.
Admission does not imply probabilistic later selection.
The model adapter exposes no provider model seed and archives solver transcripts/changed paths.

checker_evidence_contract.required_event_rule: Every completed rollout must contain at least one valid immutable-checker event, and the final event candidate hash must equal the final solver/Candidate.lean hash.
fail_closed_cases: checker, Python, command, output, or candidate mismatch
checker_evidence_contract.failure_derived_rule: Liveness requires a validated nonzero check event whose guidance snapshot precedes and differs from the produced tree; flags or failed events without the validated join cannot establish liveness.

safe_preflight.same_as_execution: Uses the frozen /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6 invocation, immutable checker bytes, injected Lean toolchain, and tracked-clean pinned EconCSLib checkout used by execution.
safe_preflight.observes: Real Lean stdout, stderr, nonzero exit status, and one recorded/tamper-checked event.
safe_preflight.forbidden_writes: No model call, quota use, formal run root, formal ledger write, DEV-002 state inheritance, or DEV-002 state mutation. Recursive state metadata snapshots and exact ledger content hashes must remain unchanged before and after preflight.

phase_and_iteration_order: The working optimizer is sampled before each rollout.
A produced optimizer enters the population only after the source rollout and Phase 2 sampling.
Only a strictly greater iteration can select an admitted candidate later.

rng_semantics.claim_boundary: EvE sampler seeding is not provider/model determinism and cannot establish a causal condition effect.
